tasks.label: Dev: Ocean
tasks.command: for p in $(pgrep -x electron); do [ "$(readlink /proc/$p/cwd 2>/dev/null)" = "${workspaceFolder}" ] && kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 0.5; npx electron-vite dev --config games/to-the-ocean/electron.vite.config.ts
